summary: Remove 29/315 from the quoted Prym–Socin example
rationale: 29/315 reads Mfakalle lu babo, məlle and concerns a father wondering about his wife and son. It does not contain ḥəlle eba w-mfakalle. The exact quoted sentence and translation occur at corpus PrS 7/20; retain the existing prs 17/28 page/line reference. The suggested 29/277 also lacks the quoted sentence and is not a replacement.
